🔬 Science Basics科学基本概念

Qualitative, quantitative, observation & interpretation定性、定量、观察与解释

Your lab partner writes "the reaction is exothermic" under Observations. On this test that line loses marks — it is an interpretation. Knowing which box each sentence belongs in is free marks.实验搭档在「观察」一栏写了「这个反应是放热反应」。考试里这句会被扣分——它是解释，不是观察。分清每句话该放哪一栏，就是白拿的分。

Difficulty难度 ●○○
⏱ 25 min · ★ essential必会

🔑 Must know必须记住 · Qualitative, quantitative, observation & interpretation定性、定量、观察与解释
  1. Qualitative = senses, no numbers. Quantitative = measured or counted numbers.定性＝感官，无数字。定量＝测量或计数的数字。
  2. Observation = qualitative, sensed directly. Interpretation = what it means, not directly seen.观察＝定性、直接感知。解释＝它意味着什么，看不见。
  3. Description = properties in words and numbers, so it can be both.描述＝用文字和数字列性质，可以两者兼有。
Observation 观察
👀 seen, heard, smelled, felt 用感官得到
e.g. bubbles formed 例：冒出气泡
heat was released 放出了热量
vs
Interpretation 解释
💭 explains what it means 解释它意味着什么
e.g. a gas was produced 例：生成了气体
the reaction is exothermic 反应放热

Qualitative vs quantitative定性与定量

Qualitative 定性
🎨 words, no numbers 用文字描述，没有数字
the solution is blue 溶液是蓝色
the metal is shiny 金属有光泽
vs
Quantitative 定量
🔢 numbers and units 有数字和单位
mass is 12.5 g 质量是 12.5 g
temperature rose by 8 °C 温度升高了 8 °C

🧗 The hard part难点 · Qualitative, quantitative, observation & interpretation定性、定量、观察与解释

Splitting one sentence into observation + interpretation把一句话拆成观察＋解释

Real sentences mix what was sensed and what was concluded.真实句子里「感觉到的」和「推断出的」混在一起。

  1. Cut the sentence at "so" / "because".在「所以／因为」处切开。
  2. For each piece: could I see, hear, smell or feel it? Yes → observation.每一段问：能看到、听到、闻到、摸到吗？能→观察。
  3. Needs a chemistry idea (reaction, exothermic, gas name)? → interpretation.需要化学概念（反应、放热、气体名称）？→解释。
Try试一试
Split: "The test tube got hot, so the reaction is exothermic."拆分：「试管变热了，所以反应是放热的。」
Answer答案
Observation: the test tube got hot. Interpretation: the reaction is exothermic.观察：试管变热。解释：反应是放热的。

⚠️ Traps & tip陷阱与提示 · Qualitative, quantitative, observation & interpretation定性、定量、观察与解释
  • "4 beakers" is qualitative → it is a count, so quantitative.「4 个烧杯」是定性 → 计数，是定量。
  • "A gas was produced" is an observation → interpretation; "bubbles formed" is the observation.「产生了气体」是观察 → 是解释；「出现气泡」才是观察。
🟡
Your class notes say an observation must be qualitative (measurements count as quantitative data, not observations). Many textbooks call measurements "quantitative observations". On this test use the class version: observation = qualitative.课堂讲义规定观察必须是定性的（测量得到的数字算定量数据，不算观察）。很多教材把测量叫作「定量观察」。考试按讲义：观察＝定性。
🎯
Circle numbers first; then split sentences at "so" or "because".先圈数字；再在「所以／因为」处拆句。

🔬 Science Basics科学基本概念

Data, experiment, hypothesis, theory & law数据、实验、假设、理论与定律

Mass before a reaction: 45.6 g. Mass after: 45.6 g. Is that a hypothesis, data, a theory or a law? The test asks exactly this — and "law" and "theory" are the pair everyone mixes up.反应前质量 45.6 g，反应后 45.6 g。这是假设、数据、理论还是定律？考试就考这个——而「定律」和「理论」是最容易搞混的一对。

Difficulty难度 ●●○
⏱ 25 min · ★ essential必会

🔑 Must know必须记住 · Data, experiment, hypothesis, theory & law数据、实验、假设、理论与定律
  1. Data = numbers from an experiment; it supports or does not support a hypothesis, never proves it.数据＝实验得到的数字；只支持或不支持假设，不能证明。
  2. Hypothesis = one unproven, testable guess ("If…, then…"). Experiment = test that gives a result.假设＝单一、未证实、可检验的猜测（如果……那么……）。实验＝得出结果的测试。
  3. Theory explains WHY and can change. Law describes WHAT, does not explain, often an equation.理论解释为什么、可修改。定律描述是什么、不解释、常写成等式。

🖼️ Picture it看图理解 · Data, experiment, hypothesis, theory & law数据、实验、假设、理论与定律

Theory vs law理论与定律

Theory 理论
💡 explains WHY 解释为什么
built from many tested hypotheses 由许多检验过的假设建立
e.g. Cell Theory 例：细胞学说
vs
Law 定律
📏 describes WHAT happens 描述发生了什么
does not explain why 不解释原因
often an equation 常写成等式，例：质量守恒定律

🧗 The hard part难点 · Data, experiment, hypothesis, theory & law数据、实验、假设、理论与定律

Theory vs law理论与定律

Both are backed by many experiments, so "how well tested" cannot tell them apart.两者都有大量实验支持，所以不能靠「检验得多不多」来区分。

  1. Does it give a reason (particles, cells, why)? → theory.有没有给出原因（粒子、细胞、为什么）？→理论。
  2. Does it only state a pattern or equation (before = after)? → law.只陈述规律或等式（前＝后）？→定律。
Try试一试
"The pressure of a gas doubles when its volume is halved (temperature constant)." Theory or law?「温度不变时，气体体积减半，压强加倍。」理论还是定律？
Answer答案
Law — it describes a pattern (PV stays constant) without explaining why.定律——它描述规律（PV 不变），不解释原因。

⚠️ Traps & tip陷阱与提示 · Data, experiment, hypothesis, theory & law数据、实验、假设、理论与定律
  • "The data proves the hypothesis" → "the data supports the hypothesis".「数据证明了假设」→「数据支持了假设」。
  • "A theory becomes a law when proven" → they never convert; why vs what.「理论被证明后变成定律」→ 两者不会转化；为什么 vs 是什么。
🟡
Your class notes define data as quantitative only (numbers from an experiment); many textbooks also allow qualitative data. The notes also say data supports or does not support a hypothesis and does not prove it — on this test write "supports", never "proves".课堂讲义把数据定义为只含定量信息（实验得到的数字）；很多教材也承认定性数据。讲义还强调数据只能支持或不支持假设，不能证明它——考试写「支持」，不要写「证明」。
🎯
Theory vs law: look for "explains", "because", "why".理论还是定律：找「解释」「因为」「为什么」。

cards.f: Qualitative vs quantitative?定性与定量的区别？
cards.b: Qualitative: no numbers, senses. Quantitative: numbers from measuring or counting.定性：无数字，靠感官。定量：测量或计数得到的数字。

cards.f: Observation (class definition)?观察（讲义定义）？
cards.b: Qualitative information gathered with your senses. Must be qualitative.用感官得到的定性信息。必须是定性的。

cards.f: Interpretation?解释？
cards.b: An explanation of what an observation means — based on evidence, not directly seen.说明观察意味着什么——有证据支撑，但看不见。

cards.f: Which statement type can be both qualitative and quantitative?哪类说法可以同时是定性和定量的？
cards.b: A description (lists properties with words and numbers).描述（用文字和数字列出性质）。

cards.f: Trap: "The reaction is exothermic because heat was released."陷阱：「因为放出热量，所以是放热反应。」
cards.b: "Heat was released" = observation; "exothermic" = interpretation.「放出热量」＝观察；「放热反应」＝解释。

cards.f: Data (class definition)?数据（讲义定义）？
cards.b: Quantitative information found by experiment; supports or does not support a hypothesis.实验得到的定量信息；支持或不支持假设。

cards.f: Hypothesis?假设？
cards.b: A single, unproven, testable educated guess — "If …, then …".单一、未证实、可检验的有根据的猜测——「如果……那么……」。

cards.f: Theory vs law in two words each?理论和定律各用两个词概括？
cards.b: Theory: explains why. Law: describes what.理论：解释为什么。定律：描述是什么。

cards.f: Is the Law of Conservation of Mass an explanation?质量守恒定律是一种解释吗？
cards.b: No — it states mass before = mass after, but not why.不是——它只说反应前后质量相等，不说为什么。

cards.f: Can a theory change?理论会改变吗？
cards.b: Yes — if new evidence is discovered it can be refined or replaced.会——发现新证据时可以修正或被取代。

quiz.q: Which statement is quantitative?哪一句是定量的？
opts: The rock feels rough岩石摸起来粗糙
Five crystals formed in the dish培养皿里长出了五颗晶体
The solution smells sweet溶液闻起来是甜的
The gas is colourless气体是无色的
quiz.hint: Any number, measured or counted, makes it quantitative.任何数字，无论测量还是计数，都使之成为定量。
quiz.why: Correct: counting five crystals gives a number, so it is quantitative.正确：数出五颗晶体得到一个数字，所以是定量。
whys: Touch only, no number — qualitative.只有触觉、没有数字——定性。
Correct: counting five crystals gives a number, so it is quantitative.正确：数出五颗晶体得到一个数字，所以是定量。
Smell is a sense with no number — qualitative.气味是感官、没有数字——定性。
Colour (even "no colour") is qualitative.颜色（包括「无色」）是定性。

quiz.q: A student writes: "The mixture turned blue and got warm, so copper ions formed." Which part is an interpretation?学生写道：「混合物变蓝并变热，所以生成了铜离子。」哪一部分是解释？
opts: "turned blue"「变蓝」
"got warm"「变热」
"copper ions formed"「生成了铜离子」
All three are observations三者都是观察
quiz.hint: Particles (ions, atoms) are never directly seen in a school lab.在学校实验室里，粒子（离子、原子）永远看不见。
quiz.why: Correct: you cannot see ions; naming them explains the colour → interpretation.正确：离子看不见；说出离子是在解释颜色→解释。
whys: Colour is seen directly — observation.颜色是直接看到的——观察。
Warmth is felt directly — observation (heat felt is an observation in this class).变热是直接摸到的——观察（本课把感到热算作观察）。
Correct: you cannot see ions; naming them explains the colour → interpretation.正确：离子看不见；说出离子是在解释颜色→解释。
Confuses evidence with the conclusion drawn from it.把证据和由证据得出的结论混为一谈。

quiz.q: Which is a hypothesis?哪一项是假设？
opts: The beaker has a mass of 52.1 g烧杯质量 52.1 g
Mass is conserved in a chemical reaction化学反应中质量守恒
If the paper towel is thicker, then it will absorb more water如果纸巾更厚，那么它会吸更多水
All matter is made of atoms that explain chemical change一切物质由原子构成，这解释了化学变化
quiz.hint: Untested + testable prediction = hypothesis.未检验＋可检验的预测＝假设。
quiz.why: Correct: a single, testable, unproven If-then prediction.正确：一个单一、可检验、未证实的「如果—那么」预测。
whys: A measured number is data, not a guess.测量出的数字是数据，不是猜测。
A well-established pattern stated without a reason is a law.不讲原因、已被反复确认的规律是定律。
Correct: a single, testable, unproven If-then prediction.正确：一个单一、可检验、未证实的「如果—那么」预测。
An explanation built from many experiments is a theory, not a hypothesis.由大量实验建立的解释是理论，不是假设。

quiz.q: An experiment gives data that disagrees with a hypothesis. What is the best conclusion?实验数据与假设不符。最好的结论是什么？
opts: The hypothesis is not supported假设不被支持
The data is wrong because hypotheses are proven数据错了，因为假设已被证明
The hypothesis becomes a theory假设变成理论
The hypothesis becomes a law假设变成定律
quiz.hint: Data either supports or does not support the hypothesis.数据要么支持假设，要么不支持。
quiz.why: Correct: data can fail to support (reject) a hypothesis.正确：数据可以不支持（否定）假设。
whys: Correct: data can fail to support (reject) a hypothesis.正确：数据可以不支持（否定）假设。
A hypothesis is unproven by definition — the data is how it gets tested.假设按定义就是未证实的——数据正是用来检验它的。
A theory is built from many supported hypotheses, not a rejected one.理论由许多被支持的假设构成，不是由被否定的假设变成的。
A law describes a well-established pattern; a failed guess is not a law.定律描述已被确认的规律；失败的猜测不是定律。
